A plain smooth grey artist's mannequin figure with ADULT proportions: very tall and thin, small head, long neck, very long arms that hang down to the knees, long legs. Strict side view facing right, full body visible, standing upright on two legs, with plenty of empty space above the head and in front of it.
It performs FOUR actions one after another, in exactly this timing:
0.0–1.0 s: idle — stands still, slightly hunched, one slow breath.
1.0–2.0 s: walks on the spot — two slow, HEAVY, deliberate steps, knees lifting, the body sinking onto each foot, long arms swinging; it does not travel.
2.0–3.0 s: reaches forward — slowly raises the right arm and stretches it far forward at shoulder height, fingers spread like claws, leaning a little forward, then holds.
3.0–4.0 s: recoils — pulls back, leans the body backwards and lifts one forearm up in front of its face to shield itself from a light in front of it, steps back once on the spot.
Every action happens ON THE SPOT: the figure never travels across the frame, it stays centered. Each action is clearly separated and finished before the next one starts.
Camera: locked static camera, no zoom, no pan, orthographic side view, the figure the same size throughout and always fully inside the frame.
Background: flat solid bright green #00FF00, evenly lit, no shadows, no floor, no props, no text.
